POST /aiservices/scribe/transcribe accepts a single local audio or video file up to 100 MB and two hours, with documented format, diarization, channel-separation, word timestamp, language, vocabulary, and polishing controls. Its JSON response includes transcript segments, speaker or channel labels, and timing fields.

Batch jobs accept cloud URI, prefix, or manifest inputs, including pre-signed object URLs, and return output locations per file. A caller-supplied reference_id is preserved for tracking and correlation across the job and status schemas.

Batch mode documents POST /aiservices/scribe/jobs plus get-status, list-jobs, cancel-job, list-files, and get-file endpoints. Jobs expose QUEUED, PROCESSING, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, and CANCELED states, while status responses include per-state file counts and result locations.

A batch submission can register notifications.webhook_url and a secret to receive an outbound POST when the job finishes. Zoom signs each request with an x-zm-signature HMAC-SHA256 value and timestamp; the docs give the exact verification string, require timing-safe comparison, and require rejection of stale timestamps.

Files are processed independently: mixed success and failure yields a PARTIAL job with succeeded, failed, skipped, and canceled counts. Per-file states include FILE_FAILED and FILE_SKIPPED; unsupported extensions are skipped with the UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA error code.
